title: How You Can Help Black Nonbelievers

top_liked.author: @scottdavis3571
top_liked.text: We need a church of secular humanism. Where we talk about our experience in leaving religion.  We can talk about the fear and shame we had to go through in religion. We were all taught to fear. We were shamed, so we taught others to fear and to shame.
